//: good: every cue names what the eye sees at the same moment, so a muted user misses nothing.
material: felt mallet on a small wooden block, dry, no reverb, no tail

mute.control: Settings > Sounds and haptics, one switch
mute.persisted: localStorage key sound, values on and off

cues.contact: 85 % through the 200 ms decelerating draw of the row's synced mark
cues.twin: the row's synced mark draws in

cues.contact: the field's shake starts with the state change itself
cues.twin: the field shakes and its inline message appears
cues.why: attention is needed and the eye may be on the list
